content.text:
This confirms my hypothesis. Commit `72940a4` removed the `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter);` call that immediately followed `findViewById(R.id.gridView)`, and instead moved it into the asynchronous `getMovies()` network-response callback (via `runOnUiThread`). But `updateUI()` only calls `getMovies()` when `movies.size() == 0`; otherwise it calls `resetImageAdapter()`, which never touches `gridview` at all. So on any path where `updateUI()` takes the "already have movies" branch (e.g., fragment recreated after rotation with cached `movies` list), `gridview.setAdapter(...)` is never called, leaving the GridView without an adapter — reproducing exactly the bug the fix (`8e40fb2`) addresses by restoring the direct `setAdapter` call after `findViewById`.

The very next commit `efd83a2` only did whitespace/cosmetic and unrelated changes and did not touch this adapter-setting logic, so it's not responsible.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 72940a4d8845f4690a5910f61c618c067d22c287

## Reasoning
(1) I traced the file history of `MainActivityFragment.java` with `git log -p --follow` to see every change to the `onCreateView`/adapter-setup logic, since the fix simply re-adds a `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter);` line right after `findViewById(R.id.gridView)`.

(2) In commit `72940a4`, the author removed the line `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter);` that immediately followed the `findViewById` call, and instead added a new `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter);` call only inside the async `getMovies()` network callback, wrapped in `getActivity().runOnUiThread(...)`. This made the adapter assignment conditional on the network fetch actually running.

(3) Looking at `updateUI()` (added earlier in `4eec65a`): it calls `getMovies()` only if `movies.size() == 0`; otherwise it calls `resetImageAdapter()`, which updates the adapter's internal item list but never calls `gridview.setAdapter(...)`. Since `72940a4` made `setAdapter` exclusively dependent on the `getMovies()` path, any time the fragment is recreated with a non-empty cached `movies` list (e.g., screen rotation), the GridView is left without its adapter ever being set — an empty/broken grid. The fix commit `8e40fb2` restores the unconditional `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter);` right after `findViewById`, which exactly undoes the problematic change from `72940a4`. The intervening commit `efd83a2` only touched unrelated lines (imports, logging, API key, whitespace) and is not implicated.

I'm fairly confident in this identification given the direct structural correspondence between the fix and the removal in `72940a4`, though I cannot run the app to empirically reproduce the crash/blank-grid behavior within this sandboxed, read-only investigation.
